headline: The best friendships don't poll for updates. You just keep the WEBSOCKET open and push random thoughts the second they happen.
caption:
The best friendships don't poll for updates. You just keep the WEBSOCKET open and push random thoughts the second they happen.

—
WEBSOCKET: a connection kept open so either side can send a message at any moment.
